name: my-reader
description: A small offline ebook reader for epub and pdf. No build step.

scripts.vendor: npm install && node -e "const f=require('fs');for(const n of ['pdf.min.mjs','pdf.worker.min.mjs'])f.copyFileSync('node_modules/pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/'+n,'lib/'+n);for(const n of ['ffmpeg-core.js','ffmpeg-core.wasm'])f.copyFileSync('node_modules/@ffmpeg/core/dist/esm/'+n,'lib/ffmpeg/'+n);console.log('re-vendored pdf.js and ffmpeg')"
